title: D-091 TW1: atomic review-slot reservation around the review/combine admission check (count-check-reserve as one step)
objective: Close M0-T170 review note 1: wrap run_budget.admit_review_or_combine in an atomic reserve/release (a file lock under the runtime directory) so two lanes can never both take the last of the 2 global review-or-combine slots or exceed 1 per lane. Fail closed on lock or state errors (no slot). Stale reservations from dead processes are released safely. Nothing in the loop calls it yet (TW2 does).
business_reason: Owner directive D-091: move the loop to the cloud server with Codex and Claude reviews and a combining model.
forbidden_paths: run_budget.py and resource_sampling.py (M0-T170, accepted; call them, do not edit)
starting or commissioning a live loop, or any owner-typed step (runbook section 12)
codex login or handling any owner credential
weakening any fail-closed check, gate, reviewer-independence rule or the orchestrator's sole authority (ADR-005)
Windows behavior changes: existing Windows paths and tests must keep passing unchanged
acceptance_scenarios: primary: two reservations succeed and a third is refused while both are held; releasing one lets the next succeed
race: two processes reserving at the same moment never both get the last slot (test with real concurrent processes or a forced interleaving)
per-lane: a lane holding a slot cannot take a second
failure: a lock or state-file error refuses the reservation (fail closed); a reservation left by a dead process is reclaimed safely, never double-counted
risks: recertification: every tools/agent_supervisor/** edit invalidates the frozen certification; one recertification task runs after all D-091 code tasks
